# near-miss: `for i` scopes to the loop body, so its writes do not extend the
# outer `i` (declared line 3, written line 4); misattribution would span 31+
# and fire. `var (a2, b2)` binds both names, so the line-36 write hits the
# destructured binding, not the outer `a2`.
# `loop-counter.dfy` rewrites `i` over lines 15-33 (span 18, at the
# 15-line minor threshold): an ordinary imperative counter the rule would
# flag on languages without Dafny's verification model.
